segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The people everyone else had written off — the cheats, the outcasts, the ones with a past — kept crowding in close to hear Jesus.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the religious men muttered about it.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: This man welcomes sinners, they said, and even eats with them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: So Jesus told them a story about how heaven really feels about one lost person.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Which of you, he asks, with a hundred sheep, would not leave the ninety-nine behind to go after the one that wandered off, and keep searching until you found it?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He does not stand there counting what he still has. He leaves the ninety-nine behind to go out after the one that is gone.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He searches through the night, over the rocks and the ravines, calling into the dark, because to him that one is not a loss he can shrug off. That one is his.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And when he finds it — frightened, tangled in the thorns, too worn out to walk — he does not scold it, and he does not leave it there.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He lifts it up, lays it across his own shoulders, and carries it the whole way home, rejoicing. Not relieved. Not annoyed at the trouble. Rejoicing.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then he calls everyone together — friends, neighbors, the whole village — and throws a celebration.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Be glad with me, he tells them. I have found my sheep, the one that was lost. Not, I got my property back. My sheep. It was his the whole time it was missing.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: That is how good he is. Heaven throws a party over one person turning back. Not a lecture. Not a grudge. Joy.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: To him, you were never one of a crowd. Have you ever felt like the one who wandered too far to be worth coming after?
